title: Avengers: Doomsday Gets First-Person Marvel Character Ad
excerpt:
A Visa collaboration shows Thor, Gambit, Beast and the Thing from a first-person perspective.
The spot is promotional rather than a new story trailer.
body_md:
Marvel Studios has partnered with Visa for a playful promotional video that puts viewers in the shoes of several Avengers: Doomsday characters. Thor, Gambit, Beast and the Thing feature in first-person sequences built around everyday activities rather than dramatic plot revelations.

The unusual camera perspective allows audiences to experience familiar superhero imagery from inside the characters' worlds. A trip across the Bifrost and ordinary errands are treated as lighthearted moments, making the advertisement distinct from the film's more conventional promotional footage.

The campaign has also revived discussion about how much of the upcoming movie Marvel should reveal. Some fans appreciate the novelty, while others would prefer a substantial trailer with new story material. The commercial should not be mistaken for confirmation of additional plot details.
